Upload self-attested copies of required documents (see Required Documents section below).
Submit the application on or before the last date (see the Important Dates section above regarding the date discrepancy in the notification).
Pay the application fee, if applicable, as notified on the Company website. Fees once paid are non-refundable.
important_instructions: Candidates must be Citizens of India. All eligibility criteria must be met as on 30.06.2026; candidature is liable to be cancelled at any stage if any criterion is not satisfied. Only full-time courses are accepted; part-time or correspondence courses are not eligible. Candidates currently employed in Government/PSU/Bank roles must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer at the time of interview. OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation. The OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate must be issued between 01.04.2026 and the date of interview. EWS candidates must produce a valid Income and Asset Certificate before the application closes. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The Company reserves the right to alter, modify, or cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts at Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: CFSL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CFSL has announced a total of 6 vacancies across 5 functional areas. Category-wise reservation is not applicable to most posts, as nearly all vacancies fall under the Unreserved/General (UR/GEN) category. The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary as per the actual requirement of the Company. Candidates from reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) may apply against these UR/GEN vacancies provided they meet the eligibility criteria for General category candidates.

content_sections.heading: CFSL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: All qualifications and experience are counted as on 30.06.2026. Only full-time courses are accepted; part-time or correspondence courses are not eligible. Where a degree certificate does not mention the specialisation, a certificate from the University/College confirming the specialisation is required. Assistant Manager (all posts): Freshers may apply; candidates with relevant internship or work experience will be given preference. Manager (all posts): Minimum 3 years of post-qualification relevant experience in the specific functional area, and the candidate must be currently employed. Employees of Central Bank of India subsidiaries with 2 years of relevant experience are also eligible. Executive Operations: Freshers may apply; 1 year of prior working experience in any company/institution is preferable.

content_sections.heading: CFSL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The CFSL selection process for all posts consists of two stages: Shortlisting: A Shortlisting Committee will decide the shortlisting parameters. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not guarantee a call for interview. Interview: The interview carries 100 marks. Qualifying marks will be decided by the Company. No travel expenses will be reimbursed to shortlisted candidates for attending the interview. Final selection is based on interview performance and an overall assessment of the candidate's experience, suitability, and current emoluments. CFSL reserves the right to offer appointment to any suitable post for which a candidate is found eligible, irrespective of the post originally applied for.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CFSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.cfsl.in or https://cfsl.in/career.php. Submit the application form online with a valid and active email ID, which must remain active until the declaration of results, as all communication will be sent by email only. Upload self-attested copies of required documents (see Required Documents section below). Submit the application on or before the last date (see the Important Dates section above regarding the date discrepancy in the notification). Pay the application fee, if applicable, as notified on the Company website. Fees once paid are non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: CFSL Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload self-attested copies of the following at the time of application, and carry originals for verification at the interview: Resume Valid Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport/Voter ID/Driving Licence) Age Proof (Birth Certificate/10th Mark Sheet) Educational Qualification Certificates and Mark Sheets Experience Certificates/Appointment Letter with latest Salary Slip Caste Certificate, if applicable (SC/ST/OBC in GoI prescribed format) EWS Income and Asset Certificate, if applicable PwBD Certificate, if applicable Candidates unable to submit an experience certificate from their present employer may instead submit the Appointment/Offer Letter along with the latest Salary Slip; the experience certificate must then be submitted at the time of joining, if selected.

faq.question: Q1. What is CFSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CFSL Recruitment 2026 is a notification (Advertisement No. CENTFIN: 2026-27:1) issued by Centbank Financial Services Limited, a subsidiary of Central Bank of India, for filling multiple contract-basis posts in Accounts, Business Development, IT, Secretarial & Compliance, and Executive Operations.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CFSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies are available across 5 functional areas. The number is provisional and may vary as per the Company's actual requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CFSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification is inconsistent on this point: the cover page lists 16/08/2026 as the last date, while Section E states the last date as 05.04.2026. Candidates should verify the correct date on www.cfsl.in before applying.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CFSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - for example, MBA (Finance)/CA for Accounts, MBA/BBA for Business Development, a relevant technical degree for IT, ACS/ICSI membership for Secretarial & Compliance, and any graduate degree for Executive Operations. See the Eligibility Criteria section above for full post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CFSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years for Assistant Manager/Manager posts and 30 years for Executive Operations, as on 30.06.2026, with age relaxation applicable to reserved categories as per GoI guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CFSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification. Fee details, if any, will be announced separately on the Company's official website.
